title: Content Library Still — speaker interaction

location.series: Cox Brand Collection — Lindsay Little / Periscope

slide_intent: Show the scale and operation of a product through a small human action so it feels usable.
strategic_value: A simple speaker interaction can keep Cox’s accessory imagery approachable and grounded in everyday objects.
demonstration: A hand reaches toward a black portable speaker resting on stacked books and a wooden side table.
practical_value: Use a hand and familiar support objects to establish scale while keeping the product silhouette unobstructed.

content_islands.name: Product and gesture
content_islands.spec: Place the speaker diagonally across the books with the hand entering from the upper right.

content_islands.name: Supporting objects
content_islands.spec: Keep the books and table below the product and the pale background largely empty.
